# Pele

`pele.global.js` and `Pele-LICENSE.txt` are copied without modification from
the official [`pele@1.6.0` npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/pele/-/pele-1.6.0.tgz)
(`dist/pele.global.js` and `LICENSE`). The package SHA-512 integrity is:

```
sha512-VfAiVItsOGlGhvnBfphdT28VCG7mXMZxQNOwAGsCtxI2ztbUsT39MraEOYjsapLxVETkdUZscm0DdotYDQMLdw==
```

The app and Quick Look use this browser bundle offline. Mermaid.js remains

for layout and feature differences.
